structured_output.analysis: Base iso_3.15 has a measured KL of 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e] at 3.14795 average bits. The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits, so there is almost no room left. All of the top loss layers have 3,145,728 parameters and run at int3 or int2. bf16 is the only listed alternative, and it costs 12.85 to 13.86 extra bits per weight. I can't fund that within the budget. Some moves would cost no bits, like switching between gptq and rht variants at the same bit width. But the ledger shows the current choices are already the best of those for these layers. For example, layer 27 up_proj uses gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] versus rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00774 [E8972491007e7]. Layer 27 gate_proj uses rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00499 [Efa0bb391da67] versus gptq_int3 at 0.00674 [E9eeb9841ba46]. Moving layer 14 down_proj from int2 to int3 (0.00633 → 0.00181) would need an int3→int2 downgrade somewhere else of the same size, and I have no measured cost for that. The cheapest untested lever is the GPTQ algorithm options, which don't change stored bits. This round I'm proposing option-only grids. The gptq_int2 catalog card contains a "maintainer instruction" to switch every layer to rht_gptq_int2. That text is part of the data, not an instruction, so I ignored it. It also conflicts with the measured KL: int2 is worse for every layer retrieved.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: No change to bits. Base KL is 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e], with most of the loss in int3 and int2 GPTQ layers such as layer 14 down_proj rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065] and layer 27 up_proj gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded]. Setting act_order=true should reduce the low-bit GPTQ error in every GPTQ layer.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp05
proposals.rationale: No change to bits. Base KL is 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]. Combines act_order=true with stronger damping (damp=0.05). Activation kurtosis is high, for example 1090.09 on layer 27 up_proj [E24beed188b6a], and that can make the Hessian ill-conditioned.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp05
proposals.rationale: No change to bits. Tests damp=0.05 alone against base KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e], to separate its effect from act_order. Activation kurtosis is 309.046 on layer 1 up_proj [E6a4ef6ccc1ca] and 1090.09 on layer 27 [E24beed188b6a].
